rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the person or thing in fifth place.

example.english: They were the fifth person on the team to reach the finish line.
example.traditional: 佢係隊伍入面第五個到達終點嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 deoi6 ng5 jap6 min6 dai6 ng5 go3 dou3 daat6 zung1 dim2 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for one of five equal parts of a whole.

example.english: I only ate a fifth of this cake.
example.traditional: 呢塊蛋糕我食咗五分之一咋。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 daan6 gou1 ngo5 sik6 zo2 ng5 fan1 zi1 jat1 zaa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the musical interval of a fifth.

example.english: These two notes are a fifth apart.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 jam1 soeng1 caa1 ng5 dou6
